name: spotify
description: 🎵 Spotify control. Actions: play (music/podcasts), pause, next, current, search, volume, devices, shuffle, share, recommend (personalized), top (top tracks), episodes (LIST PODCAST EPISODES - use for 'what are recent Joe Rogan episodes?'), suggest (music suggestions). For podcasts: 'list Joe Rogan episodes' → action=episodes query='Joe Rogan'. For music: 'play jazz' → action=play query=jazz.

action.description: Action: 'play' plays music/podcast (supports Discover Weekly, Daily Mix, etc.), 'episodes' LISTS podcast episodes, 'suggest' lists music suggestions, 'recommend' plays personalized music, 'made_for_you' lists your personalized Spotify playlists, 'top' shows most played.

query.description: For play/search/queue: what to play or search for. Can be artist, track, album, or playlist name.

device.description: For transfer: device name to play on (e.g., 'Fire TV', 'Living Room', 'iPhone')

type.description: For search: content type. For top: 'tracks' or 'artists'. Use 'show'/'podcast' for podcasts.

state.description: For shuffle: true=on, false=off. Omit to toggle.

mood.description: For recommend: mood like 'energetic', 'chill', 'focus', 'workout'. Adjusts recommendation parameters.

time_range.description: For top: time range. short_term=last 4 weeks, medium_term=last 6 months, long_term=all time.
